title: US racing to occupy Earth-Moon Lagrangian point

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. No, we are I know this. We are racing um as the United States government to occupy that space and orbit.

plain: The United States government is racing to occupy a Lagrangian point between Earth and the Moon, a spot in space where the pulls of the two bodies balance so that a craft can stay there, according to Congressman Eric Burlison. He tells Michels flatly, "I know this," and says the US is racing "to occupy that space and orbit." If he is right, that patch of space near the Moon is already being contested.
